Sales Associate, Part-Time
Fernbrook Outfitters - Downtown Store

Location: 214 Market Street, Ashford
Pay: $15.50 per hour, competitive pay with an employee discount

Join a friendly team that helps people get outside. We're a family here, and we love the work.

Responsibilities
- Greet customers and help them find the right gear
- Operate the cash register and handle returns accurately
- Restock shelves and keep the sales floor clean and organized
- Process online orders for in-store pickup
- Answer phone calls and questions about products and store hours
- Other duties as assigned

Requirements
- Must be 16 years or older
- Availability to work weekends and holidays
- Customer service experience preferred but not required
- Cash handling experience is a plus
- Must be able to lift 30 pounds and stand for long periods
- No prior retail experience required; we will train you

Schedule
Part-time, 15 to 25 hours per week, with flexible scheduling. Shifts are set two weeks ahead.

Fernbrook Outfitters is a drug-free workplace.
